brief: Quiet delta-first run (daily mode, tune-day Monday): open setups are 5 of 5 (LINK, BTC, SOL triggered; CRV, DOGE watching), so nothing new is proposed. One tripwire hit, XMR htf_pullback long, is passed for lack of a slot. ZEC is the only market where HL crowding leans (funding 30.95, 20 over CEX, OI 24h +9.68). hl-cycles reads strong_risk_off since 2026-10-31 but is stale (21.2 h), a data gap. Risk skews to chop unless BTC reclaims its 1d sma20; a daily close below 76264 would extend the down trend. Next catalyst: NFP 2026-11-06.
